source.text: Alan Rappeport / New York Times : A week after urging an Nvidia shake-up, Scott Bessent says Jensen Huang's return should depend on probes of its China chip sales and presses Nvidia for answers — The treasury secretary said on CBS that it was too soon to say if Jensen Huang should return as the company's chief executive.

draft.headline: Scott Bessent says Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO depends on China chip probes.
draft.threads_post:
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia CEO should depend on probes into China chip sales.

Speaking on CBS, Bessent said it is too soon to say if Huang should return as chief executive. The comments come a week after Bessent urged an Nvidia shake-up and pressed the company for answers.

Should CEO leadership depend on export probes?
